rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=80, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.0, unet_c=24, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-7 (breast ItNet v1). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-5 (c16,ep120,lr1e-3,a0.0) hr 0.8741 BEST; iter-6 (lr 3e-4) hr 0.8698 -> lr LOWER hurt, so lr=1e-3 already near-optimal (lever exhausted). alpha exhausted (a0.0 best). Recon == pure SmallUNet denoiser; only untested denoiser levers are CAPACITY (unet_c) and DATA (train_n). (2) FAILURE MODE: denoiser capacity ceiling at c=16 on 512^2 sparse-view. (3) ONE KNOB (capacity/architecture, allowed): unet_c 16 -> 24 (~2.25x conv cost, ~2.25x params). Budget-compensation: pretrain_epochs 120 -> 80 SOLELY to fit the 20-min wall (iter-4 c32@ep120 TIMED OUT; c24 needs an epoch cut). lr restored to the champion 1e-3. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I widen the denoiser to c=24, I expect hr above 0.8741 because the recon is now purely the denoiser output and c=16 is a small model for 512^2 sparse-view; more channels capture finer breast structure. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.8741, either c=16 was already capacity-saturated on 400 scenes OR the ep120->80 cut offset the width gain -> iter-8 disambiguates (train_n up, or c24 at more epochs if budget allows under turbo). (5) BUDGET: c24@ep80 ~ (24/16)^2 * (80/120) * 1189s ~= 1783s?? RISK -> mitigated by turbo qos (faster nodes); if it TIMES OUT, iter-7 re-dispatched cheaper (ep60). (6) Loop to iter-20.
